info.name: MV-DDSM
info.description: CBIS-DDSM full mammograms completed with the missing views and normal exams of the DDSM release distributed by RWTH Aachen (IRMA), converted to the CBIS-DDSM intensity pipeline. Coordinates are in native pixels of each image.

images.note: The CBIS-DDSM mass (BI-RADS 2, benign) was removed during the review: uncertain whether it is a mass. Flagged `uncertain`; in the paper this view was positive without any box.
CBIS-DDSM patient P_01264 merges two DDSM cases numbered A_1500: the left breast is A_1500 of benign_05, the right breast A_1500 of cancer_08.
Same film as the CBIS-DDSM image P_00192_RIGHT_CC, which carries a benign mass: not a true negative. Single view, not scored by the paired evaluation.

Matched after the dataset build by pixel identity to DDSM C_0478 (benign_13). The same film is also in the dataset as C_0478_1.RIGHT_CC (negative). Both are single views, hence not scored by the paired evaluation.
